index.name: Search index
index.description: Create a search index for the texts.

index_mode.name: Matching

values.full: Partial word match: finds parts of words too (index about 7× the text)
values.light: Whole word match: whole words only (index about the size of the text)

index_mode.help: Both find misspellings, such as OCR errors, when Fuzzy search is on.

delete.name: Remove from search index
delete.description: Delete a file's search index documents.

update_tags.name: Sync tags to search index
update_tags.description: Sync tag_label/tag_rid/tag_created_by/tag_confidence fields onto a file's existing search index documents.
